column1: # rule<TAB>file — reviewed CodeQL false positives; each is skipped only in this file. Reasons:
# clear-text-storage: session.ts keeps OIDC state + single-use PKCE verifier in tab-scoped sessionStorage across the redirect.
# user-controlled-bypass: session.ts acts on the callback `error` only when `state` equals this tab's stored state.
# xss-through-dom: image-crop-field.tsx sets only from previewImageSrc() (blob:/data:image/ allowlist).
